responsibility: Provides the detailed scheduler model for Cortex-A53, including scalar integer, load/store, floating-point, AdvSIMD, and cryptographic resources. It defines dual-issue slot constraints, structural hazards, per-pipeline reservations for ALU, multiply, divide, memory, FP/NEON, and crypto instructions, plus relevant bypasses and type classifications, and is used when tuning generated code for the Cortex-A53 microarchitecture.
